entities.summary: Elise Mertens is a Belgian professional tennis player. She became the world No. 1 in women's doubles on 10 May 2021, the third Belgian to hold a top ranking in either singles or doubles. She has won 34 WTA Tour-level titles, comprising 10 in singles and 24 in doubles.
